name: Pipeshift

modes.label: Native product; see regime notes
modes.note: Incomplete or non-resource economics: rates remain null, never interpreted as free.

caveats: Public low-latency inference orchestration product and BYOC; no verified general-purpose sandbox tariff. Custom models may fit developer compute, but no published fixed 4/8 configuration.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

Order Forms may carry a committed term (a minimum period that cannot be terminated for convenience); fees non-refundable once incurred; late fees 1.5%/month. Billing is metered usage invoiced monthly in arrears, but the metering unit (GPU-hours vs tokens) is not published.

The 'Sandbox' on the homepage is a model-API playground ('Sandbox APIs to test models and prototype your products'), not a code-execution sandbox/VM. Public API (api.pipeshift.com/openapi.json) exposes only chat completions, embeddings, rerank, audio transcription and health endpoints.

fleet.notes: Platform offers single-tenant hosted or BYOC inference and custom SLA-based autoscaling. No universal self-serve new-account GPU/replica/vCPU allowance, verification criteria or review time published; model API sandbox is not a general VM fleet.

isolation.quote: hosted (Company-managed) generative AI inference and model deployment platform, comprising dedicated single-tenant deployments, a multi-tenant serverless inference API, and the execution of Customer-provided orchestration or application logic
isolation.note: derived: the product is not a general compute sandbox with user shell access; the DPA describes 'dedicated single-tenant deployments' (isolated per-customer GPU instances) alongside a separate multi-tenant serverless inference API tier. Answer reflects the single-tenant/BYOC deployment tier this card models.

lang_python.quote: chat_completion / audio_transcription / embeddings / rerank endpoints only (FastAPI OpenAPI spec)
lang_python.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. Pipeshift is a managed model-inference API service, not a code-execution sandbox; it provides no Python runtime for running user code (the OpenAI-compatible REST API can be called from any language, including Python, but that is unrelated to an in-sandbox Python runtime).

lang_node.quote: chat_completion / audio_transcription / embeddings / rerank endpoints only (FastAPI OpenAPI spec)
lang_node.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. Same reasoning as lang_python — no Node.js code-execution runtime is provided; only a REST inference API callable from any language.

self_host.quote: Scale inference in any region globally – in our cloud or yours Rapidly scale workloads globally with our single-tenant deployments on Pipeshift Cloud or self-hosted ones in your VPC.
self_host.note: The 'self-hosted ones in your VPC' option is BYOC (Pipeshift's proprietary managed software deployed into the customer's own cloud account, per the byoc feature), not an independently self-hostable product on arbitrary infrastructure with no Pipeshift involvement. The pipeshift GitHub org has no public repositories, consistent with a closed-source platform.

open_source.quote: GitHub org 'pipeshift' (id 163000856) returns zero public repositories via the API
open_source.note: No public core-product repository found under the pipeshift GitHub org; platform is a closed-source managed SaaS/BYOC offering.

eu_data_residency.quote: Amazon Web Services, Inc. (AWS) Cloud hosting, compute, and storage India, EU, and US ... Company operates a separate instance per region, and telemetry for a given deployment is held in the instance for that deployment's region. EU, India, and United States
eu_data_residency.note: DPA sub-processor table lists EU as one of the primary hosting locations (alongside India and US) and states Pipeshift operates a separate regional instance per region, confirming customers can keep deployments/data in the EU.

max_session_h.quote: Rapidly scale workloads globally with our single-tenant deployments on Pipeshift Cloud or self-hosted ones in your VPC.
max_session_h.note: derived: Pipeshift deployments are persistent inference services that run continuously until the customer stops/removes them, not time-boxed sandbox sessions with a provider-enforced maximum runtime.

hipaa.quote: protected health information as defined by, and subject to, the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (“HIPAA”)
hipaa.note: DPA lists HIPAA-protected health information under prohibited 'Sensitive Data' categories customers must not submit; homepage only advertises SOC2 ('security compliance certifications like SOC2'), with no HIPAA/BAA claim anywhere on site.

egress_ip_type.quote: Denvr Dataworks Corp. ... GPU cloud compute; Neysa Networks Private Limited GPU cloud compute; E2E Networks Limited GPU cloud compute; Massed Compute, Inc. GPU cloud compute; NexGen Cloud Limited (trading as Hyperstack) GPU cloud compute; Nebius B.V. GPU cloud compute; Crusoe Energy Systems LLC GPU cloud compute
egress_ip_type.note: derived: Pipeshift has no user-facing sandbox/shell whose egress a customer would inspect; it runs Customer-provided orchestration/application logic on GPU clusters procured from datacenter cloud providers (AWS, Nebius, Crusoe, Hyperstack, E2E, Massed Compute, etc. per the DPA sub-processor list) and a marketplace (Shadeform). All outbound traffic from Pipeshift's infrastructure would therefore be standard datacenter-class IPs, not residential/mobile.

sso.quote: Enterprise grade security and compliance Our platform is secured with the best practices in the industry with end-to-end data encryption, regular penetration testing and security compliance certifications like SOC2. Team settings and access control (RBAC)
sso.note: The homepage's dedicated 'TRUST' section itemizes enterprise security/compliance features (SOC2, RBAC, pen testing) without any mention of SAML/OIDC SSO; no /security, /trust, or docs subdomain exists (all 404/unreachable) and no SSO/SAML claim was found anywhere on the site or DPA. The DPA describes only internal Google SSO for Pipeshift's own admin access to production systems, not a customer-facing SSO offering.
